tithi: .input {$ends :string} .match $ends sameDay {{Tithiḥ {$paksha :entity kind=paksha}pakṣasya {$tithi :entity kind=tithi} {$until :time} paryantam.}} nextDay {{Tithiḥ {$paksha :entity kind=paksha}pakṣasya {$tithi :entity kind=tithi} paradine {$until :time} paryantam.}} allDay {{Tithiḥ {$paksha :entity kind=paksha}pakṣasya {$tithi :entity kind=tithi} sakaladinam.}} * {{Tithiḥ {$paksha :entity kind=paksha}pakṣasya {$tithi :entity kind=tithi} śeṣadinam.}}
nakshatra: .input {$ends :string} .match $ends sameDay {{{$nakshatra :entity kind=nakshatra}nakṣatram {$until :time} paryantam.}} nextDay {{{$nakshatra :entity kind=nakshatra}nakṣatram paradine {$until :time} paryantam.}} allDay {{{$nakshatra :entity kind=nakshatra}nakṣatram sakaladinam.}} * {{{$nakshatra :entity kind=nakshatra}nakṣatram śeṣadinam.}}
yoga: .input {$ends :string} .match $ends sameDay {{{$yoga :entity kind=yoga}yogaḥ {$until :time} paryantam.}} nextDay {{{$yoga :entity kind=yoga}yogaḥ paradine {$until :time} paryantam.}} allDay {{{$yoga :entity kind=yoga}yogaḥ sakaladinam.}} * {{{$yoga :entity kind=yoga}yogaḥ śeṣadinam.}}
karana: .input {$ends :string} .match $ends sameDay {{{$karana :entity kind=karana}karaṇam {$until :time} paryantam.}} nextDay {{{$karana :entity kind=karana}karaṇam paradine {$until :time} paryantam.}} allDay {{{$karana :entity kind=karana}karaṇam sakaladinam.}} * {{{$karana :entity kind=karana}karaṇam śeṣadinam.}}
sankranti: .input {$when :string} .match $when nextDay {{Paradine {$at :time} samaye sūryaḥ {$rashi :entity kind=rashi}rāśiṃ praviśati.}} * {{{$at :time} samaye sūryaḥ {$rashi :entity kind=rashi}rāśiṃ praviśati.}}
moonSign: .input {$ends :string} .match $ends sameDay {{Candraḥ {$rashi :entity kind=rashi}rāśau {$until :time} paryantam tiṣṭhati.}} nextDay {{Candraḥ {$rashi :entity kind=rashi}rāśau paradine {$until :time} paryantam tiṣṭhati.}} allDay {{Candraḥ {$rashi :entity kind=rashi}rāśau sakaladinam tiṣṭhati.}} * {{Candraḥ {$rashi :entity kind=rashi}rāśau śeṣadinam tiṣṭhati.}}
